title: How TeamViewer Built a Future-Ready Global Tax Framework
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
## The Challenge: Scaling VAT and E-Invoicing Compliance Across 42 Countries


TeamViewer, a global leader in digital workplace technology, supports more than 600,000 customers worldwide and is VAT-registered in approximately 42 countries. As[e-invoicing mandates](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/e-invoicing) expanded across Europe and beyond, the company needed a scalable approach to indirect tax compliance that could support its highly customized Microsoft Dynamics 365 environment and evolving global regulatory requirements.


## The Solution: A Unified Global Tax Platform


By implementing Vertex O Series®,[Vertex VAT Compliance](https://www.vertexinc.com/solutions/products/vertex-vat-compliance) , and Vertex e-Invoicing, TeamViewer created a unified global tax platform that streamlines indirect tax determination, reporting, and e-invoicing processes. The integrated solution helps reduce manual effort, improve invoice accuracy through automation and pre-validation, and increase confidence in compliance across multiple jurisdictions.


## The Result: Greater Accuracy, Confidence, and Compliance Readiness


Today, TeamViewer is better positioned to manage changing tax requirements, including emerging e-invoicing mandates and the EU's VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) initiative, while supporting continued global growth with a connected, future-ready tax infrastructure.
